given: a location holds no stock records
when: the operator views that location on the home stock-by-location screen
then: an explicit "No stock at this location" message is shown for that location instead of a blank page or an empty table
architectural_notes: E2E: the empty result originates at app/repositories returning zero rows for the location, flows through app/services (which returns an empty collection, not an error) and the app/routes JSON boundary, and the client/ React page renders the explicit empty-state message. The empty-vs-populated branch is owned by the SPA component; the boundary returns an empty JSON array, never a 404 or blank body. Verified end to end via the real-branch integration suite (empty-location fixture, NFR4) plus the client empty-state component test.

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 cover the populated-table outcome; AC3 covers the distinct empty-location outcome, which can break (blank page shown) while the populated table still renders rows correctly, and vice versa.
